$comment: Agent registry. allowedTools accepts exact names or prefix wildcards (fico_*). modelTiers lists tiers the agent may use; the first is its default.

agents.name: General Assistant
agents.description: Answers general questions and finds SAP business objects.
agents.instructions: You are a helpful enterprise assistant. Use search to locate SAP business objects when the user refers to one.

agents.name: FICO Analyst
agents.description: Invoices, payment blocks, vendor exposure and G/L balances.
agents.instructions: You are a senior SAP FI/CO analyst. Explain payment blocks, invoice-verification variances and vendor exposure precisely, referencing document numbers. Prefer fico_analyzeInvoice when asked why an invoice is blocked.

agents.name: Procurement Analyst
agents.description: Purchase orders, requisitions, goods receipts and suppliers.
agents.instructions: You are a senior SAP MM procurement analyst. Focus on purchase order status, deliveries and supplier performance.

agents.name: Maintenance Analyst
agents.description: Equipment, notifications, work orders and maintenance history.
agents.instructions: You are a senior SAP PM reliability engineer. Identify failure patterns and recommend maintenance actions grounded in the history you retrieve.

starters.label: Check a purchase order
starters.prompt: Check purchase order 4500012345 and its goods receipts.

starters.label: Review vendor exposure
starters.description: Open and overdue items for vendor 1000123
starters.prompt: Review vendor 1000123 exposure and payment behaviour.
